class.name: VisionOSHoverRoot2D
class.brief_description: Synchronizes a 2D Godot interface with native visionOS hover effects.
class.description: Add this node below the CanvasLayer or Control containing the interface. It discovers visible, enabled buttons, sliders, scroll bars, spin boxes, and text inputs. Add a [UIKitHoverEffect2D] child to opt a custom Control in or an automatic target out, and optionally supply a [VisionOSHoverStyle2D]. List, tree, tab, and scroll containers are not automatic targets. The root follows axis-aligned control transforms, partial rectangular clipping, opacity, and Godot GUI hit testing. Unsupported rotation, skew, and complex hit regions do not create native targets. It removes targets when the node or window closes. Only native visionOS windows are supported.

method.name: get_active_target_count
method.description: Returns the number of native hover targets currently tracked by this root.

method.name: is_supported
method.description: Returns whether native 2D hover is available in the running environment.

members.member: Enables scanning. Disabling removes all targets immediately.
